data.body: CI run 32634565434 completed with failure after 1,861 seconds. Classification is test-failure. Three held-out checks could not find the string-read fields require_plan_review_for_close, require_plan_review_for_claim, and require_completion_verification_for_close in src/rebar/_config_schema.py. The local reproduction matched with three failures and one pass. No retry or corrective change occurred before classification. Root cause evidence shows that the patch extracted VerifyConfig while the configuration-read gate treats _config_schema.py as the canonical schema source. The corrective hypothesis is to restore VerifyConfig to that source, move only low-level validation helpers into the existing _config_coercion.py module, and remove historical comments that duplicate ticket or ADR context. This preserves the field markers and module-size limit.
